# Tarnbrook Tree Nursery - irrigation controller

The nursery waters its stock beds from one irrigation controller. The controller
opens a single valve at a time and writes a line to logs/irrigation.log for
every opening:

    <UTC time> OPEN bed=<name> minutes=<n> litres=<n>

`minutes` is how long the controller had been set to run that valve and `litres`
is the water that opening delivered. The plants in the north bed and the south
bed are on different watering regimes, so the two beds are opened a different
number of times over the day. The journal holds one day of watering and is not
rotated during a run.

turns.prompt: Tarnbrook Tree Nursery waters its stock beds from one irrigation controller, which writes a line every time it opens a valve. The journal for 8 September 2026 records the openings the controller made for the nursery's two beds. How many times did the controller open the north bed's valve that day? Give the count alone, as digits, with no label. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
